description: Grass clumps on a surface (input 0; without one, a 4 × 4 m ground patch at y = 0): each clump is a fan of thin two-sided blades leaning outwards; clumps are scattered by density on faces flatter than max_slope and copied as packed instances of two variants with random yaw and size. Output: packed instances (unpack for polygons); the input surface is not included. Pivot = the surface. Piece: grass (grass, double sided).

spread.desc: how far the blades lean out (fraction of the height)

max_slope.desc: no grass on faces steeper than this (degrees)

ground_size.desc: size of the ground patch used when nothing is connected (m)

clumps_src.note: two clump variants (prim attribute variant_id 0/1) of triangular blades: base on a small circle, tip leaning outwards

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (m) @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, f@tint || 1);

params.names: mask sourceprim N up orient pscale copynum variant
